title: photographing a defect before altering it

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Replace this torn tag before the photo?
turns.zh: 拍照前，我要先換掉這張破掉的標籤嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: A. I photographed the shelf. B. It came from that box. C. The damaged part is what we need to show.
turns.zh: A. 我拍過那層置物架了。 B. 這張標籤是那個箱子上的。 C. 我們要拍清楚的就是受損的地方。
